brief:
Israeli occupation forces and settlers intensified operations across the West Bank and occupied Jerusalem early Saturday, launching widespread raids into multiple cities, towns, and refugee camps, Shehab Wire reported. The incursions involved home invasions, arrests, and gunfire directed at Palestinian residents and facilities.

The coordinated operations unfolded across numerous locations simultaneously, reflecting an escalation in the frequency and scope of military and settler actions in the occupied territories. Security forces deployed to conduct the raids alongside settlers who participated in the attacks on Palestinian communities. The Saturday operations continued a pattern of heightened confrontation that has characterized recent weeks in the West Bank and Jerusalem.

title: Israeli forces and settlers escalate attacks across West Bank.
